text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
To rescue so many of them from the 
machine... You're quite skilled at crane 
games, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
How is everyone doing? Doesn't the breeze 
outside feel absolutely wonderful?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let us all express our gratitude to our 
benefactor.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, let me thank you as well. Thank you 
very much, Trainer.
